title: Register ReadWrite
text: Read from or write to various bit fields of TI C2000 Registers, 1 input, 1 output, {Device family} sets Select TI C2000 device family; {Register group} selects required register groups, {Register name} selects register name, {Register field} selects register filed, {Access register using} selects register access, {Operation} selects read or write, {Insert code before/after} sets the insert code before or after, {Bit to process} sets the custom bits and {Register bit fields} selects bit field. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device family
params.values: Select TI C2000 device family None (default) | F2804x | F280x | F281x | F2833x | F2844x | F280013x | F280015x | F28002x | F28003x | F28004x | F2802x | F2803x | F2805x | F2806x | F2807x | F2837xS | F2837xD_CPU1 | F2837xD_CPU2 | F2838x_CPU1 | F2838x_CPU2 | F2838x_CORTEXM4 | F28M35x | F28M35x | F28M35x | F28p65x_CPU1 | F28p65x_CPU2

params.name: Access register using
params.values: Select register access Specified bits (default) | Custom bits

params.name: Operation
params.values: Select read or write operation Read (default) | Write

params.name: Insert code before/after
params.values: Insert code before or after None (default) | EALLOW/EDIS

params.name: Register bit fields
params.values: Select bit field to access All (default)
